title: Write merged-task facts back into task packets and evidence (closeout pass)
goal: Three task packets stayed at in-review/in-progress after their PRs merged (#327, #329, #330), so the packets and their evidence described branch-time intentions rather than merged facts. Write the merge facts back (PR, merge commit, merged-at, branch closure, signal classification on the merge commit) and add a closeout record per task, plus one consolidated record for this pass. Registering the advisory Core Smoke signal discovered while walking main's runs (red since at least 2026-09-05 behind a green workflow conclusion) belongs to the same pass because it is the second instance of the FR-010 class.
statusNote: 2026-09-20: writeback delivered on chore/merged-packet-closeout - the three merged task packets flipped to completed with closeout sections, per-task closeout records appended to their evidence summaries, FR-011 registered for the long-standing red advisory Core Smoke job, and this pass's own packet/evidence added. Status flips to completed once this PR merges.
technicalDebtNote: The repo has no automated link between a merge and its task packet, so every packet drifts to in-review until someone writes it back by hand; this pass is manual by construction. The deeper gap it surfaced (advisory Core Smoke red for two weeks with no gate) is recorded as FR-011 but deliberately not fixed here.
dependencyLayers: platform harness governance (task packets, evidence, failure registry)

in: .harness/evidence/<those three>/summary.md: append a per-task closeout record
docs/harness/failure-registry.md: FR-011 (advisory Core Smoke red without a gate) with review-date refresh
.harness/tasks/2026-09-20-merged-packet-closeout/ + matching evidence dir: this pass's own record
out: fixing or re-scoping the advisory Core Smoke job (why the smoke-core tenant specs fail in CI needs its own task)
any gate policy change (advisory-to-blocking promotion stays a maintainer decision)
product code, workflows, tests, permissions, i18n, menus
writing back the packets of merges this workstream did not own (#325, #326, #328)

doNotTouch: the review.md and commands.json of the three closed-out tasks (historical records stay as written)

commands: gh pr view {327,329,330} --json state,mergedAt,mergeCommit,statusCheckRollup (merge facts + PR signal classification)
gh api repos/.../commits/<sha>/check-runs (required vs advisory signal on the merge commits and on main tip)
gh run list --workflow=smoke-core.yml --branch main + per-run job conclusions (29 red of 32 completed runs)
node scripts/check-duplication.mjs / check-doc-frontmatter / check-encoding / check-structure-contract / check-method-health

evidenceRequired: commands.json with the GitHub lookups that establish each merge fact and the gates re-run after the writeback
summary.md with the consolidated closeout record and the FR-011 finding
